title: Replicating Activation Probe Pipeline With Quantized (4-bit) Models

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly addresses whether safety monitoring techniques work under the conditions practitioners actually use (4-bit quantization). If probing degrades under quantization, it invalidates a key assumption about accessibility of interpretability-based monitoring.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires running the full 'A Few Bad Neurons' pipeline twice (full precision and quantized), plus comparing neuron sets with Jaccard similarity. bitsandbytes NF4 is standard but activation extraction from quantized models may have quirks for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two conditions (full precision vs. 4-bit) on the same model and pipeline. Clear deliverable: comparison table of probe accuracy, neuron overlap, and correction rates. Feasible in 30 hours if the pipeline is already documented.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
